instructions: Review each item under `## Failing checks`, `## Check annotations` and decide whether it needs a code change.
Review each body under `## Review summaries (first look)`. Eligible non-human IDs are already in `--minimize-comment-ids`. Record any warranted Shepherd Journal note before review mutations.
For each `external` failure, open its URL and inspect it.
Inspect every referenced range under `## Check annotations` and apply any warranted change.
Do not add annotation IDs to resolve or minimize mutations.
If you changed code, commit any remaining changes and push. Otherwise, do not commit or push.
For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal 42 '- <decision>'`.
Link threads and comments from their headings. Cite reviews by ID.

`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. After completing these steps, continue with the next poll using the same interface and mode: rerun the current `pr-shepherd` CLI invocation with its flags, or call MCP `iterate` again.
